column1: # W0lfSword CVE catalog  -  the ONE source the `cve` command renders (AUD.4).
#   id        CVE id, or the repo's own finding tag (BB-032, bad_query, bl_sbx, ...)
#   class     short bug class shown in the "Class" column
#   component the component/technique shown in the "Component" column
#   fixed_in  the release that fixes it ("unpatched" / "kernel-gated" when it applies)
#   live_on   where it is still reachable (the "Live on" column)
#   groups    comma separated filter names, from: kernel,userspace,sandbox,tcc,ssv,live
#             (`cve <name>` selects the rows carrying that group; `cve live` is
#             the cross cutting "still reachable today" set)
# file order = display order. `cve all` prints every row below; each filter prints
# its own subset in the same order.
#   - append a row, do not reorder  -  `cve all` output is diffed in review
#   - a row here must have a write-up somewhere the audit can find it: research/,
#     BUG_BOUNTY.md, pocs/, README.md or ROADMAP.md. scripts/cli_consistency.py
#     fails the audit on an orphan row (a CVE nobody has evidence for).
#   - no tabs inside a field, no empty field, id unique
